_readme: Hand-edited inputs for scripts/build_data.py: content that is a judgment or a game rule, not data read from the .md files.
Values here are merged into KS_DATA as-is. A key that the .md parser also produces is an error (the build fails).
Field meanings: docs/SCHEMA.md. Keys starting with '_' are ignored.

rules.drillCamp: Slotted heroes auto-level to the lowest of the 5 instructors' levels (in-game text, 22 and 25 Oct and 5 Nov) and use no XP. Level Resets set a hero to Lv 1 and refund all their Hero XP (in-game text, 22 and 25 Oct). A hero removed from Drill Camp returns to its own level (kingshotguides.com Drill Camp guide, 2025-03-25).
rules.oneMarchPerHero: A hero can be in only one march at a time.

skillBooks.text: Skill book counts (a/b on a skill's Upgrade button) are your shared stock of that book type, not progress saved on that skill. Each rarity has its own books: Epic heroes share Epic books, Mythic heroes share Mythic books, so books spent on one Epic hero are gone for every other Epic hero. Book type names are read from the icons. Which book upgrades which skills comes from a guide, because the screens show only icons: Conquest Skill Books upgrade Conquest skills (Arena and Conquest stages) and Expedition Skill Manuals upgrade Expedition skills (marches and rallies); until 5 Nov the names were swapped here. A skill's level is capped by stars: your screens show the cap is one more than the stars (1★ → Lv 2 … 3★ → Lv 4), and a guide confirms Lv 5 needs 4★.
skillBooks.source: You, 25 Oct (shared stock); heaven-guardian.com and kingshotmastery.com, read 5 Nov (book names, Lv 5)
skillBooks.confidence: Verified (shared stock, star caps on your screens); Unverified (book names)

redeemShards.text: The Redeem count on a hero's promotion screen is a shared stock of shards per rarity: Epic heroes share Epic Redeem shards, Mythic heroes share Mythic ones, so shards redeemed for one hero are gone for the others of that rarity. How many hero shards one Redeem shard gives is not recorded.

drillCamp._instructorNote: From the Drill Camp screen of 5 Nov: the 5 instructors all show Lv 64. The screen shows no names; left to right they look like Jabel, Chenko, Seth, Quinn and Diana, and these are exactly the five heroes whose own 5 Nov screens show Lv 64 without the Drill Camp message (Olive showed Lv 63 then, reaching Lv 64 later on 5 Nov, and Edwin Lv 59), so the identification is firm. Seth took Olive's place since 27 Oct. The screen text says "Heroes within a Drill Slot will auto-level to the Level Minimum of the 5 instructors". The 8 slots hold, by portrait and class icon, Amane, Helga, Howard, Gordon, Yeonwoo, Fahd, Forrest and Saul, all Lv 64, and each of them shows Lv 64 with the Drill Camp message on their own 5 Nov screen. Slot 9 needs Town Center Lv 23 and slots 10-15 are locked. On 27 Oct the instructors were Jabel 64, Diana 61, Olive 59, Chenko 59 and Quinn 64, so slotted heroes ran at Lv 59.

recommendations.what: Gathering: Olive in Gat, plus a Wood preset
recommendations.summary: Gathering heroes work from any slot, so with Olive, Gat covers iron, stone and bread. Your troops fill about 1.5 full marches, so Wood takes what Gat leaves.
recommendations.why: A gathering hero's bonus works from any place in the march: guides only say the matching hero must travel with it. A march takes one Infantry, one Cavalry and one Archer hero. Your Gat preset (Seth Infantry, Edwin Cavalry, Amane Archer) already covers iron (Seth +20%) and stone (Edwin +15%), but Amane has no gathering skill. Olive is also an Archer and adds +20% bread, so Gat then covers iron, stone and bread. Wood needs Forrest (+20%), an Infantry hero like Seth, so it needs its own preset with heroes not in Gat.

changes.note: Troops: what is free; with Gat out, about 48,500 (1,048 / 3,640 / 43,843)

steps: Deploy → Gat → replace Amane with Olive → Save; send Gat to iron, stone or bread tiles.
Save a free tab as Wood: Forrest, Fahd and Amane; send it to wood tiles with the free troops (about 48,500 while Gat is out).
Forrest is no longer in Be (Helga took his place on 5 Nov), so Wood can go out at the same time as Be.

Diana is your second-strongest hero, but her march skills only help beast hunts (stamina, hunting speed), so she adds little there (inferred). Saul (2★) may fit later.

recommendations.summary: Raises Defense for all heroes from 10% to 12.5% in the Arena. Then Quinn's Headshot and Diana's Incendiary Arrows.
recommendations.why: Conquest Skill Books upgrade Conquest skills, the ones used in Arena battles and Conquest stages. They are one shared stock, so each 50 buys one Lv. 3 → 4 upgrade for one hero. (These were called Expedition Manuals here until 5 Nov: your screens show only icons, and a guide gives the names the other way round.) Joint Defense raises Defense for all heroes from 10% to 12.5%, and Howard is in the front of both Arena squads; his Shielded Strike reached Lv. 4 by 5 Nov (Lv. 5 costs 75). Guides give Quinn's Arena order as Headshot first and Diana's as Incendiary Arrows first, so those come next.
steps: Keep the 29 Epic Conquest Books until you have 50.
Then Howard · Joint Defense (all heroes +10% → +12.5% Defense; front of both Arena squads).
After that: Quinn · Headshot (Attack × 480% → 520%), then Diana · Incendiary Arrows (250% → 270%, AoE 84% → 91%); both are in the back of both Arena squads.

recommendations.what: Long term: Jabel, then Howard and Quinn
recommendations.summary: Mythic: Jabel. Epic: Howard and Quinn for fights, Chenko for joining. Skip Helga unless you spend. Generation 2 arrives around day 40–50.
recommendations.why: A guide calls Jabel "the only Generation 1 mythic a free-to-play player can fully build", and she is your only Mythic in the combat line-ups. Guides put Amadeus at the top of Generation 1 (not recruited, 0 / 20; he comes from VIP packs) and tell free-to-play players to skip Helga; general Mythic shards cannot be used on her. Saul is not the weakest: one guide says he has the highest Attack of the launch heroes in Arena, but he is in no line-up of yours, and his value to you now is Resourceful (+9% construction speed, −9% cost). Among Epics, guides call Howard "the best infantry a free-to-play player has at launch" and Quinn "the only farmable epic archer with two combat Expedition skills"; Diana is rated for PvE, and her stamina cut keeps her useful. Generation 2 heroes arrive around kingdom day 40–50 and Generation 3 around day 105–120; you have none of the Generation 2 heroes yet.
steps: Mythic: Jabel's 4★ from her own shards; keep general Mythic shards for a Generation 2 hero (see the Mythic shards move).
Mythic books: Jabel's Youthful Rage and Persistence are Lv. 4; Lv. 5 needs her 4★. Not Saul's.
Amadeus: collect his shards from free events when offered (0 / 20 on 22 Oct); buying him only makes sense if you plan to spend.
Epic shards and books: Howard and Quinn first for combat, Chenko for joining rallies; Diana for beast hunting and the Arena.
Generation 2: when Zoe, Hilde or Marlin appear (Hero Roulette, Hall of Heroes), ask for an updated plan.
